en.answer: Monster Tokens disappear when they leave the field, and cannot be returned to the Deck. When you Special Summon a <<12762>> with its own procedure, you cannot include Tokens among the 10 cards that you must return to the Deck.
en.question: When Special Summoning a <<12762>> by returning 10 other cards with different names from my hand or field to the Deck, can I return a Token to the Deck?
en.title: When Special Summoning a <<12762>> by returning 10 other cards with different names from my hand or field to the Deck, can I return a Token to the Deck?

ja.answer:
モンスタートークンはフィールドを離れる際には消滅し、デッキやエクストラデッキに戻る事はありません。

「<<12762>>」を特殊召喚する際に、モンスタートークンをデッキ・エクストラデッキに戻すカード10種類に含める事はできません。
